frontend_surface.intent: Existing country/manager operational workspace for fund review, import, anomalies and maintenance. Reuse as W2 back-office candidate instead of creating a second country admin application.

api_runtime_findings.finding: Current app.js mounts routes_vl.js, and routes_vl.js transitively mounts routes_vl_admin.js. Country Panel fund-list routes are therefore part of the current monolith route graph.
api_runtime_findings.proof: src/routes/routes_vl.js contains require('./routes_vl_admin')(app) around line 5729; live GET probes return HTTP 200.

api_runtime_findings.finding: services/funds/routes.js also contains TODO placeholders for overlapping routes, but that microservice scaffold is not the current production authority.
api_runtime_findings.proof: Current PM2 production authority remains app.js monolith; overlapping microservice TODOs must not replace working monolith routes.

api_runtime_findings.finding: Frontend calls /api/importfondsvl but current API repository search did not find an active implementation with that route name.
api_runtime_findings.rule: Do not create a new upload route until historical equivalent uploadsfilevl/import logic is mapped and authorization/validation semantics are compared.

api_runtime_findings.finding: routes_vl_admin.js itself contains multiple admin/user mutation/read routes without authenticate at declaration level, while newer PUT routes in the same file use authenticate.
api_runtime_findings.rule: Never fix the panel by simply mounting the whole legacy file. Route-by-route RBAC/ownership review is mandatory.

api_runtime_findings.finding: src/lib/api.ts provides a centralized authenticated GET/POST/upload client, but many Country Panel pages still use direct fetch and therefore bypass this common auth/error-handling layer.
api_runtime_findings.rule: Migrate incrementally after API contracts are certified; do not rewrite all screens at once.

keep: Existing Country Panel URLs and user workflows where valid.
Fund Master and country/regulator/currency reference APIs.
Existing country-specific automated pipelines and audit staging.
extend: Country-specific publication lag and source status.
migrate: Direct fetch calls toward shared authenticated API clients.
Legacy text identity toward stable fund/societe IDs after reconciliation.
Generic file import toward country adapter contracts rather than one untyped upload endpoint.
do_not: Do not migrate Country Panel to inactive services/funds TODO routes; harden the currently mounted monolith routes in place or behind additive compatible adapters.
Do not create a second Country Panel.
Do not let a country operator bypass canonical pipeline quality gates.
Do not allow arbitrary country/pays query parameters to grant cross-country access without RBAC ownership checks.

next_action: Certify route-by-route auth/RBAC and import contract semantics for the currently mounted Country Panel. Preserve working URLs; repair security/ownership and missing import contracts additively before frontend convergence.
